title: AI CO-PILOT RECIPE: IT INFRASTRUCTURE (VARIANT C)

sections.title: ⚠️ THE REALITY CHECK
sections.content: AI favors 'easy' over 'secure'. It will suggest `chmod 777` or root access by reflex. **Always verify:** Check for least-privilege permissions.

sections.title: 🗺️ THE BIG PICTURE
sections.content:
**Global View:** Declarative, reproducible home lab and server deployments.
**The Motivation:** Stop building 'Snowflake' servers. Use Docker and automated configs to make your infra immortal.

sections.title: 🛠️ THE SETUP
sections.content:
**Prerequisites:**
- Debian 12 / Ubuntu Server
- Docker & Docker Compose
- Tailscale (Zero Trust Access)

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'I want to deploy [Service] on Debian. Outline the network bridge and storage layout.'*

steps.label: Failure
steps.content: AI suggests root user for everything.

steps.label: The Fix
steps.content: Force AI to use non-root service accounts.

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'Write the docker-compose.yml. Map volumes to ./data. No exposed DB ports.'*

steps.label: Manual Check
steps.content: Are passwords hardcoded? Any accidental 0.0.0.0 exposures?

steps.label: Guardrails
steps.content: Run `docker-compose config` to validate YAML before spinning up.

steps.label: The Prompt
steps.content: *'Give me the terminal commands to bring this stack up and check logs.'*

sections.title: 🛡️ GUARDRAILS & TESTS
sections.content: **Validation:** Always use static image tags (e.g., `postgres:16`) instead of `latest`. Use `checkov` to scan for misconfigurations. **Snapshots:** Always take a VM snapshot or backup your compose files before applying AI-generated networking changes.

sections.title: 🔭 NEXT STEPS
sections.content:
**Future Learning:** Learn `Proxmox` for full VM orchestration.
**Links:** Official Docker docs at `docs.docker.com`.
